CheckTitle: Ensure Transactions Created/Updated by Fusion Administrators Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: Transactions created, updated or approved by IT administrators should be monitored.
Risk: Administrators acting on business transactions bypass normal separation of duties.
AuditProcedure: Review the transactions in Reports and Analytics.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 41001-41012, 42001-42004.

Steps: Reverse the transaction where possible and fix the configuration that allowed it.
